reasons: The claimed deviation is supported: Section 9 (p0059-p0060) contains only a Y2K date-processing warranty, with no professional/workmanlike, conformance-to-documentation, compliance-with-laws, malicious-code warranty or any remedy, so an insert is the correct treatment.

The redline is a clean additive insert at the end of Section 9 that leaves the existing Y2K language untouched and reaches the preferred position: workmanlike performance of Hosting/Support Services, 12-month conformance of the Interface and software to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with laws, and a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy at Vendor's option.

The assessment that no change to the p0076 disclaimer is needed is accurate, since it is already prefaced 'EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT' and therefore does not swallow the new express warranty.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix, and correctly offers the 90-day fallback; deterministic checks (operation applies; period expressed in months) are satisfied.
